sections.title: CLI scope
sections.content: A user invokes the local CLI health command and receives deterministic JSON. No HTTP server, GUI, database or gateway.

sections.title: Local contract
sections.content: The command returns status ok on success. Failures return a nonzero process code with a diagnostic. No network API is introduced.

sections.title: Validation
sections.content: Node tests validate the local command. The same validation contract runs locally and in CI.
